changelog: Chain of Command: a card that takes a target now leaves a free One-Shot copy in your hand to aim somewhere else. Surge makes every building act again: depots draw, barracks muster a Rifleman. Late-game medal rewards offer a much wider spread instead of the same few. A boss is briefed once, on the march, not again as the fight opens. A card upgraded mid-fight shows its upgrade right away. The final act's climax now has a proper entrance, a wide road to it, and stays in sight once it appears.
